answer: Locks are recorded in island, expire in meadow, and mesa lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 69 aliases thus needs 45 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2104 identities would post 3837 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
